transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I came in because, for the last few weeks, I just haven’t had much of an appetite. Even after work, foods I normally like just kind of sit there, and I’m forcing myself to take a few bites.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

Yeah… most days I do feel pretty down. It’s like this heavy, flat feeling I carry around. Even when I’m at home with my family or just sitting in the break room at work, I feel like I’m there, but not really there.
Have you lost any weight recently?
Yeah, a little, I think. I haven’t really been eating much these last few weeks. Even stuff I usually like after a shift, I just kind of pick at it and force down a few bites.
Have you noticed a significant amount of weight loss?

Not a significant amount that I know of. I mean, my appetite’s been pretty bad these last few weeks, so I’m probably down a little, but I haven’t really checked closely. I’m mostly just barely eating and forcing a few bites when I do.
Have you lost more than 5% of your body weight over the last month?

I don’t know that it’s been more than 5%. I haven’t really weighed myself. I just know for the last few weeks my appetite’s been really low, and even food I normally like after work, I’m kind of forcing down a few bites.
Have you noticed your clothes fitting differently due to weight loss?

Not really with my clothes, no. I haven’t noticed them fitting looser or anything. It’s more that I just haven’t had much appetite lately, and I’ll sit with food I usually like after work and only manage a few bites.
Have you experienced any weight loss that you would consider significant?

I wouldn’t call the weight loss significant, no. What I have noticed is that for the last few weeks I’ve barely had an appetite. Even after a shift, foods I usually like just kind of sit there, and I’m forcing down a few bites.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?
I’m not sure. I mean, I don’t have one specific thing I’m feeling guilty about. Nothing really comes to mind when you ask it that way.
Have you been exercising more than usual lately?
No, I wouldn’t say I’ve been exercising more than usual. If anything, my routine’s been about the same.
Do you think you are underweight or overweight?

I don’t really think of myself as underweight or overweight. The main thing is just that lately I haven’t had much appetite. Even food I usually want after work, I kind of have to force myself to eat a few bites.
Do you think there's anything wrong with your body shape or weight?

No, I don’t think there’s anything wrong with my body shape or weight. It’s more that I just haven’t had much appetite these last few weeks. Even stuff I usually like after a shift, I’ll sit there with it and only force down a few bites.
Do you think about your weight or body shape often?
No, not really. I don’t spend much time thinking about my weight or body shape.
Have you been making yourself vomit after eating?
No, I haven’t been making myself throw up after eating.
Have you been engaging in any physical activity to try to burn off calories?
No, I’m not doing any exercise or anything to burn off calories. That’s not really what’s going on for me.
Do you think there are any parts of your body that you dislike?
Not really, no. I mean, there are things I probably don’t love, like anyone, but I don’t focus on any part of my body or feel especially bothered by it.
Do you think your weight or body shape is a problem?
No, I don’t really see my weight or body shape as the problem. It’s not something I’m especially worried about.
Do you think your lack of appetite is related to your feelings of sadness?

Yeah, I think it probably is. Most days I just have this heavy, flat feeling, like I’m there but not really there, even at home with my family or sitting in the break room. When I’m feeling like that, eating just doesn’t really come to mind much.
Did your lack of appetite start at the same time as your feelings of sadness?

Yeah, around the same time. It’s been about three weeks now, since they reorganized security at the casino and changed my assignments. That’s when I noticed I started feeling down, and my appetite dropped off too.
Do you think you would have less of an appetite if you weren't feeling sad?

Yeah, I think so. When I’m not feeling like this, I can usually eat fine, especially after a shift. Lately though, even foods I normally like just kind of sit there, and I have to force down a few bites.
